descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S22 Supervisor-list scan time and which AI read the photo

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 Each supervisor-list scan records which AI model read the photo, and logs the AI call time separately from the total. (UAT 3.9; UAT 3.5)
  • T2 Photo scanning runs on Google Gemini Flash via Vertex AI. (TFA-94425 AC 1)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given The S04 supervisor-list image

When Scan it 10 times through ai/vision:scanCensusSheet in snf mode

Then Every call leaves an aiCallLog row with the model, durationMs and providerMs. The model is a Gemini Flash model on Vertex. Calls over 30 s are listed for review. The toggle itself is not timed (no target, Q9)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Deterministic: one aiCallLog row per call with model + durationMs + providerMs (U9). The model names Gemini Flash on Vertex (T2). Timing is a target, not pass/fail: calls over 30 s are flagged for review (3.5, Q9)

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PERF · Performance timing; secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-09/S22

Tickets: TFA-94425 Implement Vision/photo path (ready for qa)

Lane in the dev run folder newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

Dev, build e02167f, dataset photo10. The S04 supervisor-list image is not on disk, so a synthetic Nursing Home census photo (4 QA-prefixed rows) stood in; it was scanned 10 times (10 copies, a fresh sheet each time) from the Nursing Home list and the sheet closed without adding, so Today's Visits was never replaced. Each call left one vision.scanCensusSheet row: model gemini-3.6-flash, durationMs 1816-3001 ms (median 1978), providerMs on all 10; none over 30 s. 20/20 judged cells held (U9, T2). Vertex itself is not proven (admin read, as in TC-02/S19). Every scan showed 'No residents found' (known B01, recorded only). The In Today toggle is not timed (no target, Q9).

Evidence: 1 attached; 1 not attached:

  • newspec-c/evidence/photo10/evidence/TC-09-S22-nh-after-10-scans.png — a dev screenshot, not attached
